mainEntity.name: How much does kitchen cabinet refacing cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen cabinet refacing varies based on the size of your kitchen, the materials you select, and the complexity of the installation. Generally, refacing is 30% to 50% less expensive than replacing all cabinets. For example, solid wood veneers and doors will be at the higher end, while laminate or thermofoil options can be more budget-friendly. To get an accurate estimate, we offer free consultations where we can measure your kitchen and discuss your material preferences and any desired hardware updates.
